# has inference commitment

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:hasInferenceCommitment`](gmeow-hasInferenceCommitment.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/hasInferenceCommitment>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/inference`](../../slices/inference.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates an occurrent [`gmeow:InferenceProcess`](../classes/gmeow-InferenceProcess.md) (the reasoning episode) to the endurant [`gmeow:InferenceCommitment`](../classes/gmeow-InferenceCommitment.md) (the argument structure) it instantiates — the bridge across the [gUFO](../../external/ontologies.md#target-gufo) endurant/occurrent divide that keeps the two faces of inference distinct yet linked. NOT functional: one reasoning episode may settle several arguments.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:InferenceProcess`](../classes/gmeow-InferenceProcess.md) -> [`gmeow:InferenceCommitment`](../classes/gmeow-InferenceCommitment.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:hasInferenceCommitment`](gmeow-hasInferenceCommitment.md) from [`gmeow:InferenceProcess`](../classes/gmeow-InferenceProcess.md) to [`gmeow:InferenceCommitment`](../classes/gmeow-InferenceCommitment.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

### Abduction

- **Source:** [`slices/core/inference/examples/abduction.ttl`](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/slices/core/inference/examples/abduction.ttl)
- **Examples catalog:** [open in catalog](../../examples/index.md#example-slices-core-inference-examples-abduction)#example-slices-core-inference-examples-abduction

```turtle
@prefix gmeow: <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/> .
@prefix ex:    <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/examples/inference/> .
@prefix rdfs:  <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix xsd:   <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .



# --- The occurrent reasoning episode (perdurant) ---------------------------- #
ex:diagnosticReasoning a gmeow:InferenceProcess ;
    rdfs:label "The clinician's diagnostic reasoning episode"@en ;
    gmeow:experiencer ex:clinician ;                          # functional: one episode, one reasoner
    gmeow:mentalProcessType gmeow:processReasoning ;          # the canonical occurrent marker (no eventTypeInference)
    gmeow:eventTime "2026-06-15T10:05:00Z"^^xsd:dateTime ;
    gmeow:eventTemporalFrame gmeow:temporalFrameUTCGregorian ;
    gmeow:hasInferenceCommitment ex:abductiveCommitment ;     # occurrent -> endurant bridge
    gmeow:producesMentalMoment ex:beliefInfluenza .           # production: reasoning creates this new belief (a MentalMoment)
```
